name: 7plus
description: Browse 7plus catch-up shows and play clear HLS episodes in Jellyfin.
overview: Australian catch-up TV from 7plus. DRM-protected episodes are labelled and cannot be played by this plugin.

versions.changelog: Refreshes empty Jellyfin channel caches, loads public 7plus component shelves without account-token filtering, reports unexpected empty shelf responses, and cache-busts the updated 7+ logo while preserving Jellyfin's image resource convention.
